cases.description: When the internal `sections[1]` is null (no records have been added to section 1), `getSection(1)` should return an immutable empty list.

cases.expected: Unmodifiable list containing two dummy Record objects in insertion order
cases.description: After adding two records to section 2 via `addRecord(recordA, 2)` and `addRecord(recordB, 2)`, `getSection(2)` must return an unmodifiable view of the underlying list preserving the order of insertion.

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException when attempting to add a Record to the returned list
cases.description: After adding a record to section 2, `getSection(2)` returns an unmodifiable view. Trying to modify this view (e.g., `list.add(dummy)`) must throw `UnsupportedOperationException`.

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException when attempting to remove an element from the returned empty list
cases.description: When the internal `sections[1]` is null, `getSection(1)` returns `Collections.emptyList()`. Any mutating operation on this list (e.g., `remove(0)`) should raise `UnsupportedOperationException`.
Calling getSection with a negative index should throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because the internal sections array is accessed directly without validation.
Calling getSection with an index equal to or greater than the length of the internal sections array (which is 4 in a standard Message) must throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
If the internal `sections` field is unexpectedly null (e.g., forced via reflection), any call to getSection should result in a NullPointerException when attempting to index the null array.
